verdict.rationale: Retell documents concrete concurrency limits (default 20 concurrent calls for Pay-As-You-Go, configurable reserved inbound concurrency) and lets you monitor concurrency via the analytics dashboard, giving platform engineers clear numbers to plan around. However, there is no documented self-service mechanism to raise the default 20-call cap or auto-scale beyond it — the docs don't describe how enterprises get higher concurrency without contacting Retell support, so 'without manual capacity begging' isn't fully evidenced. missing for 10: documented self-service quota-increase/scaling process, independent verification of large-scale concurrent call handling.
